title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Time and Work
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 6 days. B alone can do the same work in 12 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
questions.explain:
Let total work = LCM(6, 12) = 12 units. 
Efficiency of (A + B) = $12 / 6 = 2$ units/day. 
Efficiency of B = $12 / 12 = 1$ unit/day. 
Therefore, Efficiency of A = (A + B) - B = $2 - 1 = 1$ unit/day. 
Double the work = $12 \times 2 = 24$ units. 
Time taken by A alone to do double the work = $24 / 1 = 24$ days.
